description.value:
Duration constant

You're immune to the Rejecting (Load 9) and Consumed (Load 10) bands' listed penalties, and your Load can climb past 10 with no hard cap — no matter how high it gets, treat its mechanical effects as though capped at Overgrown (6–8). The story's outrun you: any NPC connected to the Rendery who hears your name reacts to it, unprompted, before they react to you.
